title: Phase Correlator for Heterogeneous Rollouts and Shadow Reconciliation
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a phase correlator to align A/B and canary phases across heterogeneous model variants and introduces a reconciliation path for shadow traffic. No public API changes. Backwards compatible with existing rollout policies.
description:
Motivation:
We observe frequent desynchronization between staged canaries, A/B lanes and shadow traffic when model variants have non-uniform latency/queue profiles (heterogeneous capacity). This leads to skewed telemetry and spurious rollbacks. This PR introduces a lightweight Phase Correlator runtime component and a shadow reconciliation handler to keep phase epochs and safety gates aligned across variants and to reduce false positives in autosafe rollback logic.

What this change does (single-line summary):
Introduce phase-correlator service and reconciliation hooks that: 1) compute an epoch alignment token per rollout phase, 2) annotate requests/responses for cross-variant correlation, 3) reconcile shadowed responses asynchronously to update safety-gate signals without perturbing live traffic.

Why now / context:
ENG-1722: recurring incident where canary promotors tripped due to asymmetric warmup. PM-311 requested a mitigation that preserves rollout fidelity while reducing manual rollbacks.

Design notes and constraints:
- Correlator runs as a thread-safe in-process component in the routing layer; non-blocking and bounded memory.
- Uses epoch tokens attached to request metadata (propagated over internal headers) to compute per-variant drift metrics.
- Shadow reconciliation forks response summaries to a reconciliation queue; asynchronous aggregator updates the rollout controller via a bounded channel.
- Does not change user-facing API or telemetry schema; adds rollup metrics under rollout.phase_correlator.* and reconciliation.histogram.*
- Works with existing fallback policies: if correlator is disabled or backpressured, system falls back to current per-variant heuristics.

Checklist (manual steps before merging):
- [x] Unit tests for epoch generation and token propagation
- [x] Integration test for correlated shadow reconciliation with synthetic latency skew
- [x] E2E smoke in staging with canary + shadow lanes
- [x] Docs draft for rollout operators (console + CLI)
- [x] Telemetry mapping added to observability-pack

Commits (high-level):
- 7a3b2d1 Add phase correlator core and token generator
- b4c1f77 Integrate correlator into router request pipeline
- d92e11a Shadow reconciliation queue and aggregator service
- e0f7ab2 Metrics and tracing for correlator and reconciliation path
- 4f3c9b6 Tests: unit/integration/e2e harness updates

Files changed (high-level):
- router/phase_correlator.rs (new) - core correlator implementation and tests
- router/mod.rs - wire correlator into request flow
- controlplane/rollout_controller.go - reconciliation hooks and aggregator consumer
- observability/metrics.yaml - new rollup metrics
- docs/rollouts/phase_correlator.md - operator-facing docs and troubleshooting
- integration-tests/synthetic-latency/skewed-shadow.test - new test harness
- examples/rollout-configs/hetero-shadow.yaml - example config for QA
- ci/pipeline/flake-fix.sh - small CI helper to stabilize concurrency tests

Deployment / rollout plan:
1) Deploy correlator in staging with correlator.enabled=false by default and run e2e smoke.
2) Enable correlator for shadow lanes only in a single region for 24h; monitor rollout.phase_correlator.drift and reconciliation.lag metrics.
3) Gradually enable correlator for canary traffic in low-traffic accounts with manual gating.
4) If reconciliation confidence < threshold for 2 hours, automatically scale reconciliation workers; if still low, fallback to heuristics (existing behavior).

Rollback behavior:
- Correlator is opt-out via config flag; rollback is a config flip and restart of router process. No schema migration needed. Aggregator writes are idempotent and keyed by epoch token so replaying does not corrupt state.

Backward compatibility:
- Internal headers used for token propagation are within the internal-only header namespace (x-rw-epoch). Existing services that ignore unknown headers remain unaffected.

Open questions / future work:
- Consider adding a sampled full-response reconciliation path for high-risk cohorts (follow-up ENG-1807).
- Explore exposing drift insights in Console as a cross-variant heatmap (PM roadmap).

CI / test summary:
Initial CI run: unit tests passed, integration tests timeout on one flaky concurrency test (integration-tests/synthetic-latency/skewed-shadow.test).
Second CI run (after flake fix): all checks passed. See ci_checks below for per-check details.

Related: ENG-1722, PM-311, SUP-908

Merge notes:

review_conversation: Diego Ruiz (2026-02-11): Left a couple nits on concurrency guards in phase_correlator.rs. Can we bound the reconciler queue size?
Maya Chen (2026-02-11): Thanks — added a bounded MPSC queue with backpressure policy and updated tests to simulate queue saturation.
Ava Patel (2026-02-13): Suggested we add a synthetic test that simulates variant restart and token collision; also asked for clearer observability names.
Maya Chen (2026-02-14): Added synthetic restart test and renamed metrics to rollout.phase_correlator.* per observability naming guidelines.
Jordan Kim (2026-02-18): Concerned about the potential for reconciliation lags to bias SLOs. Requested a manual gating period and config knobs.
Maya Chen (2026-02-19): Added config: correlator.reconciliation.enabled (default true) and correlator.reconciliation.max_workers with sane defaults and docs.
Ava Patel (2026-02-21): Approved after one last nit on a log message. (LGTM)
Diego Ruiz (2026-02-22): Approved. Verified staging e2e run and metrics presence.
Jordan Kim (2026-02-24): Quick follow-up question on aggregator backoff; pending but doesn't block merge.

merge_outcome: Merged into main after addressing concurrency flake and adding staging smoke. Release notes will include rollout operator guidance and default flags to control reconciliation.
notes_for_ops: Config knobs: correlator.enabled (bool), correlator.reconciliation.enabled (bool), correlator.reconciliation.max_workers (int), correlator.epoch_ttl_seconds (int). Monitor rollout.phase_correlator.drift, reconciliation.lag, reconciliation.error_rate. If reconciliation.lag > 60s for 15m, scale workers or toggle reconciliation.enabled=false.

examples/rollout-configs/hetero-shadow.yaml:
  rollout: 
    name: hetero-shadow-demo
    phases: 
      - name: canary
        fraction: 0.05
        correlator: 
          enabled: true
          reconcile_shadow: true
